description: Steps from Place de la République in central Paris, spacious 125 m² 5-room apartment with elegant décor, marble and wooden floors. 4 bedrooms (2 beds 180×200, 1 bed 140×200, 2 beds 90×200), living-dining room, equipped kitchen, 2 bathrooms and 2 separate toilets. Fully air-conditioned. Ideal for up to 8 adults. Luggage drop-off from 11:30 AM, check-in from 4PMThe spaceThe whole apartment is for you!Possibility to leave your luggage from 11:30 p.m. while the maid cleans and return from 4:00 p.m. for check-in.This 5-room apartment with luxurious decor (up to 8 adults) consists of:an entrance, a large living and dining room with television, a fully equipped kitchen (Nespresso coffee machine, toaster, electric kettle,washing machine, dryer, dishwasher, oven, microwave, refrigerator and freezer.)4 bedrooms including:bedroom N°1 with a 160X200 bed, a desk and a wardrobe,bedroom N°2 with a 180X200 bed, a television, a desk and wardrobe,bedroom N°3 with a 180X200 bed, a television, a desk and wardrobe,Bedroom N°4 with two 90X200 beds, a desk and a wardrobe,2 shower rooms, two separate toilets.All with central air conditioning (A/C) in every room.Sheets and towels are provided.On request: We can put a baby cot and a high chair at your disposal!Find everything you need when you arrive: coffee capsules, tea, salt/pepper, oil, detergent, body and hair shower gel, hair dryer, iron etc... :)We have 4 other apartments in the same building with different accommodation capacities! If you come in a group, don't hesitate to ask if other of our apartments are available! :)For the day of departure: a luggage locker is at your disposal in the courtyard of the building to leave your luggage there after check-out time.Guest accessThis accommodation will offer you the luxury of being in the hea

issues: The opening summary and detailed room list disagree about bed sizes.
The bedroom images show made beds, but do not independently resolve whether the fourth-room image contains two separate 90 cm beds.
The hall images show an internal level change/step, but do not establish the complete route to required rooms or the entrance.

themes: Guests praise the location, comfortable and spacious apartment, effective AC, smooth check-in and responsive, helpful host.
One reviewer specifically praises the shower and clear entry instructions.

deepReview.note: The full-size bedroom photos show a king-size bed in bedroom 2 and a broad made bed in the room labeled with twin beds, so that image does not independently confirm two separate sleep surfaces. Kitchen and dining areas are visible. Bathroom photos show a shower and WC fixtures; the hall includes a small level change, so complete step-free access is not established.
